Title: Azure Kinect DK coming to Japan, Germany, and the United Kingdom

Body.Content:
Thanks to considerable market interest in the Azure Kinect DK, starting in March 2020 it will be available for purchase in Japan, Germany, and the United Kingdom.

The Azure Kinect DK is a developer kit with advanced AI sensors for building sophisticated computer vision and speech models. Designed for versatility, it combines an advanced depth sensor and spatial microphone array with a video camera and orientation sensor, along with multiple modes, options, and SKDs.

Learn more about the Azure Kinect DK.
